hooks.command: sh -c 'p=$(cat); if [ -n "$TUIOS_SOCKET" ] && [ -n "$p" ]; then case $p in (*PermissionRequest*) w=330;; (*) w=2;; esac; o=$({ printf "{\"id\":1,\"verb\":\"agent-hook-event\",\"params\":{\"harness\":\"%s\",\"forwarder\":true,\"env\":{" claude-code; s=; for v in TUIOS_AGENT CODEX_THREAD_ID CURSOR_VERSION GROK_SESSION_ID CRUSH_SESSION_ID; do eval "x=\${$v-}"; case $x in ("") ;; (*[!A-Za-z0-9._:/@+=-]*) ;; (*) printf "%s\"%s\":\"%s\"" "$s" "$v" "$x"; s=,;; esac; done; printf "},\"payload_json\":"; printf "%s" "$p"; printf "}}\n"; } | nc -U -w "$w" "$TUIOS_SOCKET" 2>/dev/null; echo .); o=${o%.}; case $o in (TUIOS-HOOK-OK?*) printf "%s" "${o#TUIOS-HOOK-OK?}"; exit 0;; esac; fi; printf "%s" "$p" | exec tuios agent-hook claude-code --integration 3'
